_comment: Loot tiers. The tier/examples/feeds mapping below is my reading of the handoff's loot table, which is still collapsed in the rendered PDF - correct it if I guessed wrong.

Components.sourceHint: Logical locations - pharmacy for medicine, arcade for wiring and lenses.

Relics.sourceHint: Rare caches. Present and visible in darkness but unreadable - the object renders, its value does not. Lighting it is the whole reason to turn light on, and an invisible relic could not tempt anyone. DECISIONS.md row 53.

RestorationCrates.sourceHint: Fixed spawns. Team-carried; a carrier cannot fight normally.

burden._note: Chris's playtest call: ordinary loot must not make a raid feel sluggish. Only relics impose a small movement penalty; supplies, components, and restoration crates do not.

banking._comment: Every item recovered during a run requires extraction. Relays never insure a haul, and no paid item may bypass this loss rule.

LoadingDock.note: Reliable, but never free: hold the dock for 20 seconds while the storm closes in.

FreightLift.note: Deeper second exit. Its 30-second lift wait is the cost.
